nominal_geometry: Waveshare UGV01 vendor model remains unchanged
selection_rule: effective track width and gyro weight selected from synchronized encoder/AprilTag heading; 0.192 m minimized yaw error and direct gyro blending was rejected because it worsened trajectory fidelity
held_out_interpretation: the earlier 0.1818 m encoder-only estimate improved on the new camera run; 0.192 m is the refined same-run calibration and still requires confirmation on a separate run
important_limitation: the 0.192 m value is a provisional tracked-surface effective width, not a replacement for the 0.141 m physical chassis geometry; IMU yaw remains available for bias, slip, uncertainty, and security evidence
